title: Terms of Use – Spin the Wheel
description: The plain terms for using Spin the Wheel: what the service is, what you may do with it, and what it is not.
heroText: Use the tools freely for real draws of your own. These terms say what the service is, what you may not do with it, and how the free service works.

sections.title: What the service is
sections.body: Spin the Wheel is an independent site run by its owner. It offers a random picker wheel, preset wheels and a random team generator, all free and running in your browser on your device. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any other wheel, picker or random-draw site or brand.

sections.title: How you may use it
sections.body: You may use the tools for classrooms, games, giveaways and decisions of your own, and share results you produce. You may not disrupt or automate the site in ways that degrade it for others, or resell the service as your own. Draws are random; a result is final once shown, and the site does not mediate disputes about outcomes.

sections.title: Subscriptions and changes
sections.body: Spin the Wheel is free. There are no paid plans, subscriptions or charges today: the wheel, the presets and the team splitter run on your device, with no account. If the site ever introduces paid features, this page will state their billing, cancellation and refund terms before anything is charged. The [privacy policy](/privacy/) explains what happens to data you send, and a problem with the site goes through the [contact form](/contact/).
